release_status: Fixes are on main; v0.1.10 does not contain either scheduling fix.
platform: Native Windows; Intel i9-14900K; NVIDIA RTX 5080
process_priority: Normal; no Task Manager priority change or high-priority stall watcher
graphics: Live process inventories confirm System32 D3D11 and DXGI; no local d3d11 proxy

route.setup: Developer mission load, active-player verification, invincibility, menu close, 2s settle; excluded from controller phase
route.traversal: Subway stairs to sidewalk, brick corner, right strafe, crosswalk
route.input: W 4000ms; W 3000ms; D 1600ms; W 3000ms; 25s controller observation
route.limit: Identical initial replay and position; input polling and path diverge after starvation. No full-route equal-workload FPS claim.

isolation: Fresh identical 33-byte settings seed, no saves or app shader cache at start, private full game-data copy. Real save/settings membership, sizes and SHA256 unchanged. No process-memory writes.

historical_trace.limit: Rate-limited sparse trace, not a complete interval record. Buffered log clocks cannot establish exact video/pose alignment.

video.source_capture: Owned-window Windows Graphics Capture (FFmpeg gfxcapture), NVENC; recorder affinity 0xfffcffff excludes game cores
video.alignment: Approximate controller-start alignment estimated from recorder QPC/progress receipt; latency is not bounded. CFR may duplicate captured frames. Independent game telemetry and read-only poses corroborate old loss of progress.
video.coverage: 24-second excerpts; approximate old mapping does not cover the final ~0.64s of its full 25s controller phase. Not physical scanout.

limitations: Reporter hardware and exact room are unknown. This reproduces a scheduling-sensitive freeze under deliberately restricted CPU capacity, not that exact machine.
The CPU0 affinity workaround was not tested; both game tests already exclude CPU0 by using E16/E17.
One combined scheduling intervention changes two mechanisms; neither individual effect is isolated.
OS and driver caches uncontrolled. Observer overhead unmeasured. Current timeline adds GPU queries/logging absent from the historic build.
Default vs restored-scheduling no-video comparison uses the same executable, timeline, controller, seed and data; one intervention case, two clean default cases.
Accepted software frame intervals are not physical display timing. Some shorter hitches remain.
An earlier current run with an unverified local SCSKiller proxy was excluded; its files are preserved locally.
No Proton or other hardware validation; no release artifacts published.
